news.title: High number of new and inexperienced directors
news.body: There are 7 new directors who have joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: 7 new directors. No experienced directors. No highly experienced directors. Non-Executive Independent Director Jankiben Brahmbhatt is the most experienced director on the board, commencing their role in 2024. The following issues are considered to be risks according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model: Lack of board continuity. Lack of experienced directors.

news.title: Axentra Corp Limited announced that it has received INR 200 million in funding from Minerva Ventures, Al Maha Investment Fund Pcc - Onyx Strategy
news.body: Axentra Corp Limited announced that it has completed a private placement and issued 10,000,000 equity shares at a price of INR 20 per share for aggregate gross proceeds of INR 200,000,000. The transaction has been approved by the board of directors and included participation from J\L Maha Investment Fund PCC-0 YX STRATEGY for INR 50,000,000, Altitude Investment Fund PCC - CELL 1 for INR 50,000,000, Green Horizon Fund PCC - Cell 1 for INR 50,000,000 and Minerva Ventures Fund for INR 50,000,000.

news.title: Axentra Corp Limited Appoints Palaniappan Kumarappan as Managing Director
news.body: Axentra Corp. Limited at its Extra Ordinary General Meeting on January 3, 2026 approved the appointment of Mr. Palaniappan Kumarappan as Managing Director of the company.

news.title: Axentra Corp Limited Announces Board Appointments
news.body: Axentra Corp. Limited held its Extra Ordinary General Meeting on January 3, 2026. The meeting included the regularization of Mr. Vinoth Kumar Mohanadas by appointing him as an Executive & Non-Independent Director of the company, the regularization of Mr. Yasiru Lelwala by appointing him as an Executive & Non-Independent Director of the company, and the regularization of Mr. Nirmal De Soysa Cooke by appointing him as a Non-Executive & Independent Director of the company.
